sources.title: GitHub - ketayon/QUANTUM_LLM: Hybrid Quantum-Classical LLM NLP Model ...
sources.snippet: 🔬 Quantum-Enhanced Transformer Classification with LLM Science Dataset This project explores various model strategies for classifying science multiple-choice questions using a high-quality dataset. It combines classical NLP methods (BERT) with quantum machine learning (QML) techniques to study their comparative performance.
